skills.name: Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to four forward slashes, dealing Ice DMG.
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear is considered an  attack.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Converging Spear
skills.description:
While in the  state and Basic Attack: Converging Spear can be used, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches the corresponding Basic Attack: Converging Spear based on the current stage, dealing Ice DMG.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear has three stages. Each use advances it to the next stage. After performing the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, it resets to the first stage.
If Sigrid is attacked while charging the 1st or 2nd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, she blocks with her shield. On a successful block, the attack's DMG is negated, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear deals 100% more Daze, the  state is refreshed, and she gains one use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. Press [Basic Attack] after a successful block to perform the corresponding stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.
Basic Attack: Converging Spear performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
DMG taken is reduced by 60% during this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable during the third stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear.

skills.name: Special Attack: Frostflower
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Performs three forward thrusts, dealing Ice DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade
skills.description:
With enough Energy and while not in the  state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an  attack.
When EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade
skills.description:
With enough Energy and while in the  state, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Performs a series of powerful lunging stabs ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an  attack.
When EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade is chained after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear's hit count will be retained.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dodge: Cloudstep
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Windchase
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Performs a forward cleaving slash, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Counterthrust
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Condenses frost around the spearhead before unleashing a powerful counterattack, dealing Ice DMG.
When performed after Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, Dodge Counter: Counterthrust retains the current stage of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear.
This skill is considered an  attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a powerful piercing attack against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, gains the Tempered effect, increasing the DMG dealt by subsequent Basic Attack: Converging Spear attacks by 20% for 50s.
When the current skill hits a Stunned elite or boss enemy for the first time, the current stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is recorded and then reset before entering the  state. While in , 's duration will not be reduced. Hold [Basic Attack] to continuously activate the 1st through 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. After activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear,  ends and Basic Attack: Converging Spear's stage is restored to the recorded stage.
 can trigger at most once against the same target before the target recovers from Stun.
This skill is considered an  attack.
While in the  state, Basic Attack: Converging Spear does not trigger the Chain Attack window when hitting Stunned enemies.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Frozen Heavens
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Gathers the power of extreme cold before unleashing a devastating series of lunging attacks, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an  attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Iron Sentinel
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Condenses ice before lunging forward, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Dauntless Cold
skills.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Swings the spear upward before following with a powerful downward attack, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill is considered an  attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Sky Knight
skills.description:
The 4th hit of Basic Attack: Frost-Tipped Spear, EX Special Attack: Scattered Jade, EX Special Attack: Shattered Jade, Assist Follow-Up: Devouring Frost, Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice, Ultimate: Frozen Heavens, and Dodge Counter: Counterthrust are considered  attacks.
Whenever Sigrid hits an enemy with any  in combat while not in the  state, she enters the  state and gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
While in the  state, when Sigrid hits an enemy with an  skill, the  state is refreshed and she gains 1 use of Basic Attack: Converging Spear that cannot be stacked.
When triggering or refreshing , its duration decreases as the stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases. At stage 1/2/3, its duration is 8/7/6s.
When  ends, the stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear is reduced by one, to a minimum of stage 1.
Activating or refreshing  increases Sigrid's CRIT Rate by 66% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.
When Sigrid hits a Stunned enemy while in , the Stun DMG Multiplier of her DMG dealt to the target is increased by 20%.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Legion of the Skies
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
Sigrid's ATK increases by 120. This effect scales with character level, with each level providing an additional increase of 12, up to a maximum increase of 840.
DMG increases by 15% when hitting enemies in the Contamination state.

mindscapes.name: Long, Long Ago
mindscapes.description: Upon activating the 3rd stage of Basic Attack: Converging Spear, enters the Aerial Patrol Spear and gains 1 additional activation of Basic Attack: Converging Spear. When activations exceed the stored Basic Attack: Converging Spear's activation limit, the next Basic Attack: Converging Spear's final hit deals an additional 100% of ATK as Ice DMG. Sigrid's ATK increases by 25%.

mindscapes.name: Legend's First Act
mindscapes.description: PEN Ratio of Unbridled Spear attacks and Basic Attack: Converging Spear increases by 24%. The duration of Aerial Patrol Spear is extended by 2s. Sigrid's Decibel Generation Rate increases by 10%.

mindscapes.name: Protector of Miracles
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Hero in Training
mindscapes.description: Each time upon gaining Aerial Patrol Spear, DMG dealt increases by 18% for 8s. Repeated triggers extend the duration by 8s, up to a maximum of 40s.

mindscapes.name: Skybound Oath
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Knight of the Skies
mindscapes.description: When Basic Attack: Converging Spear's 1st/2nd/3rd stage's final hit lands, it deals an additional 80%/90%/100% ATK as Ice DMG. There is no more limit on the number of times Sigrid can enter the Formation Breaker state upon hitting a Stunned enemy with Chain Attack: Encroaching Ice. Formation Breaker state's Basic Attack: Converging Spear will activate faster.
